name: KA-SAT 2022 (Viasat) - ATT&CK
description: KA-SAT / AcidRain attack of 24 Feb 2022 mapped to MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20. Score = attack phase (1-6). Sources: Viasat incident overview (30 Mar 2022), SentinelLabs AcidRain analysis.

techniques.comment: Phase 1: Misconfigured VPN appliance gave remote access to the trusted management segment (Viasat).
Phase 2: Lateral movement through the management network to the segment used to operate the network. Specific remote service not disclosed.
Phase 3: Legitimate, targeted management commands executed on many modems simultaneously; used to run the AcidRain binary (Viasat, SentinelLabs).
Phase 4: Modems trusted the provider management plane. Provider-to-customer direction; ATT&CK models customer-side abuse of a third party.
Phase 5: AcidRain (as root) recursively overwrites and deletes non-standard files.
Phase 5: AcidRain overwrites /dev/sd*, /dev/mtdblock*, /dev/mmcblk*, /dev/loop* etc. (up to 0x40000 bytes).
Phase 5: Erases /dev/mtd* flash via MEMGETINFO/MEMUNLOCK/MEMERASE/MEMWRITEOOB IOCTLs. Modems recoverable by factory reset (Viasat).
Phase 5: Redundant reboot attempts after wiping leave the device inoperable.
Phase 6: High volumes of malicious traffic from SurfBeam2/2+ modems in Ukraine from ~03:02 UTC (Viasat).
